==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Sw0rd''' is based on the light novel and anime series "[[wikipedia:en:Sword_Art_Online|Sword Art Online]]". 
* His neck wrinkles are result of his neck being wrapped by umbilical cord. He is open about this and considers it his trademark. 
* Wants to learn English, Chinese, and Japanese.
* He doesn't like coriander but other than that he likes every type of food. 
* His music interests are: J-Pop, Rap, and songs from animation. 
* Considers [[Khan]] his close friend.
* Was one of the first Korean imports to play in Turkey, along with his former teammate [[Reach (Lee Joo-won)|Reach]], when he joined [[Team Turquality]] for the [[TCL/2016 Season/Winter Season|TCL 2016 Winter Season]].
** When he reached the LCK with [[Griffin (Korean Team)|Griffin]], he also became the first player to play in the LCK after playing in Turkey.
